payload.description_html: Vertebrate remains from the Rockport Quarry Limestone Formation. (D) a small spine from ?Tamiobatis sp. (previously identified as Ctenacanthus sp.) from the Rockport Quarry Limestone at the abandoned Kelly Island Limestone Quarry at Rockport State Park, Alpena County, UMMP 13147. Scale bar equals 1 cm.
